releaseBuild.message: dbt build and physical relation verification succeeded

physicalRelation.redaction: Values are replaced by MD5 fingerprints; hashes support equality/non-null verification only.

sourceDerivedCause.explanation: The start response had ASSET_MISMATCH and the refreshed evidence is MISSING. Neither has a rule, rule version or binding, so neither is rerunnable; the rerun service rejects an empty eligible scope. The REST resource wraps that exception as MODEL_SPEC_GOVERNANCE_QUALITY_START_FAILED after the status transition.

qualityStart.conclusion: The dbt/Airflow build and physical relation verification succeeded. Quality workflow was not started because no rerunnable, bound governance rule matched the physical asset; this is not an Airflow/dbt execution failure.

secondMaterialization.reason: The UI materialization action was disabled while the candidate remained QUALITY_RUNNING; no second RELEASE_BUILD run exists. This does not cover the later, separate MANUAL operational-run request.

catalogSemanticSync.runtimeObservation: dts-analytics received POST /api/semantic/publish for public.dwd_s104_detail_retry with dataSourceName=null and returned HTTP 400.
catalogSemanticSync.rootCause: The analytics database registry contains zero rows. The semantic publish endpoint cannot resolve a database with dataSourceName absent, therefore returns its datasource-not-found HTTP 400 response.

manualOperationalRun.rootCause: The platform swallowed the underlying runtime exception after two recovery attempts, so its persisted code is only MODEL_OPERATIONAL_DISPATCH_RECOVERY_FAILED. The absent deterministic Airflow DagRun proves no task started. Source flow shows the nested terminal path is Airflow submission outcome unknown when trigger/get cannot establish the DagRun; the exact upstream HTTP/transport exception was not persisted or logged by the platform.

readOnlyScope: No retry, candidate status update, database write, or service restart was performed.
